item_name: Rothco Kids Reversible Camo Jacket With Hood
item_short_desc: Rothco's Kids Reversible Camo Jacket features a waterproof nylon outer shell and reversible fleece liner.
description: Rothco's Kids Reversible Camo Jacket features a waterproof nylon outer shell and reversible fleece liner. The kid's hooded camo jacket features two exterior and interior slash pockets with a drawstring hem waist and elastic wrist cuffs. The camo jacket is ideal for the winter season.
